# Data-quality report (generated by data_quality.py)

## Orders

- All-zero Orders on all 72 dates: ['Prochlorales']. process_V6.py labels every non-chloroplast p__Cyanobacteria read "Cyanobacteria" (Greengenes 13_8 via SINTAX), so Prochlorales is folded in by construction. Treated as 23 effective Orders; fixed at 0 and never a candidate parent.
- Mean % (72 dates): Rickettsiales 31.52, Rhodobacterales 19.40, Flavobacteriales 16.99, Oceanospirillales 10.19, Alteromonadales 9.35, Vibrionales 2.39, Cyanobacteria 1.76, Methylophilales 1.46, Pseudomonadales 1.30, Burkholderiales 0.76, Actinomycetales 0.71, Bacillales 0.67, Rhodospirillales 0.66, Verrucomicrobiales 0.51, Rhizobiales 0.47, Enterobacteriales 0.41, Xanthomonadales 0.41, Desulfobacterales 0.34, Legionellales 0.30, Sphingomonadales 0.25, Sphingobacteriales 0.13, Planctomycetales 0.02, Opitutales 0.00, Prochlorales 0.00.
- Read depth per sample (all reads): 4,884-37,277; reads in the 24 Orders (the denominator of the response): 3,562-26,839.
- Orders with median expected read count < 5 per sample (noise-dominated; expect constants): ['Desulfobacterales', 'Opitutales', 'Planctomycetales'].

## Vibrionales outliers

- 2003-08-04: Vibrionales 77.8% (224 robust SDs above the median 0.39%), Rickettsiales 0.9%, sample ['PML_46_2003_08_04'], depth 11,998 reads.
- 2003-06-09: Vibrionales 40.1% (115 robust SDs above the median 0.39%), Rickettsiales 15.1%, sample ['PML_43_2003_06_09'], depth 10,224 reads.
- 2007-06-04: Vibrionales 6.4% (17 robust SDs above the median 0.39%), Rickettsiales 23.4%, sample ['PML_0006_2007_06_04'], depth 13,077 reads.
- Fitted both ways: window w72 (with) and w72noVib (without 2003-06-09 and 2003-08-04). Through the sum-to-100 constraint, a 78% Vibrionales date also depresses every other Order on that date.

- 82 samples -> 72 dates. Dropped (10): ['PML_0029_2008_01_28_Dp', 'PML_0030_2008_01_28_Np', 'PML_0031_2008_08_27_Dp', 'PML_0032_2008_08_27_Np', 'PML_0033_2008_08_28_Np', 'PML_0034_2008_08_28_Dp', 'PML_0035_2008_04_22_Dp', 'PML_0036_2008_04_22_Np', 'PML_0037_2008_04_22_D', 'PML_0038_2008_01_28_D']. Every retained date has exactly one sample.

## Predictors

- MDI+MDN+MNA+MPI vs MCH: max relative difference 0.068%: raw size classes are collinear with MCH and are never used with it.
- fpico+fnano+flarge = 0.9995-1.0007: the three proportions are themselves collinear, so Sets C/D use fpico and flarge only.
- |r| > 0.8 among candidate predictors (72 dates): ['MNT-MPO 0.97', 'MCH-MPY 0.88', 'MCH-MPP 0.96', 'MPY-MPP 0.86'].
- S4 PRMT dates ['2008-03-17', '2008-06-23', '2008-09-22', '2008-12-08'] present in every window covering 2008: True.

## Cyanobacteria vs chloroplast misassignment

- Chloroplast reads removed upstream (SINTAX class = Chloroplast at cutoff 0.5): 14.8% of all reads; per date 0.0%-44.2%.
- Reads kept as "Cyanobacteria" whose unthresholded best class call is Chloroplast (i.e. plastids that slipped under the cutoff): 76 of 11,107 (0.68%). Best class calls: Synechococcophycideae 10,898, Oscillatoriophycideae 95, Chloroplast 76, 4C0d-2 27.
- Spearman rho, Cyanobacteria % vs removed-chloroplast fraction: -0.02 (p=0.86). Leakage would make these co-vary.
- Mean Cyanobacteria % by month: 1:1.6, 2:2.7, 3:1.9, 4:1.0, 5:0.3, 6:1.5, 7:1.2, 8:3.4, 9:5.1, 10:0.8, 11:1.0, 12:1.2.
- Highest dates (Cyanobacteria %, suspect share of its reads): 2008-09-22 13.5% (0.1%); 2003-08-25 10.3% (0.1%); 2006-09-12 9.9% (0.0%); 2004-08-23 6.7% (0.4%); 2008-03-17 5.9% (0.5%).
- Largest suspect share on any date: 35.3% on 2003-05-26, where Cyanobacteria is 0.30% (17 reads).
- **Verdict: plastid contamination of Cyanobacteria NOT SUPPORTED.** The late-summer peaks are reads whose best class is Synechococcophycideae, consistent with the known Synechococcus maximum at L4.
